title: Global linear convergence of entropy-regularized softmax policy gradient beyond tabular MDPs
abstract: arXiv:2605.24939v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study the global convergence of policy gradient for infinite-horizon entropy-regularized Markov decision processes (MDPs) with continuous state and action spaces. We consider log-linear softmax policies with linear function approximation, which extend the tabular softmax parameterization while retaining a tractable policy class. Under $Q^\pi_\tau$-realizability up to a state-dependent baseline for the regularized state-action value function, we establish a non-uniform Polyak-Lojasiewicz (PL) inequality for two different feature regimes. The non-uniformity arises through degeneracy of the state-averaged Fisher information matrix in the first feature regime and the uncentered feature second-moment matrix in the second. In both regimes we prove that these non-uniform constants can be bounded uniformly from below along the gradient flow. translated_abstract: 我们研究了具有连续状态和动作空间的无限时域熵正则化马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）的策略梯度全局收敛性。我们考虑采用线性函数逼近的对数线性softmax策略，它扩展了表格型softmax参数化，同时保持策略类易于处理。在正则化状态-动作价值函数满足（直至一个状态相关基线的）$Q^\pi_\tau$可实现性的条件下，我们针对两种不同的特征情形建立了非一致的Polyak-Lojasiewicz（PL）不等式。这种非一致性在第一种特征情形中源于状态平均Fisher信息矩阵的退化，在第二种情形中源于未中心化的特征二阶矩矩阵的退化。在这两种情形下，我们都证明了这些非一致常数可以沿梯度流被一致地下界约束。对于具有全仿射跨度的特征，我们证明了KL正则项的径向无界性，并表明……
tldr: 该论文在连续状态-动作空间和线性函数逼近设定下，通过建立非一致PL不等式并证明其常数沿梯度流一致下有界，首次证明了熵正则化softmax策略梯度超越表格型MDP的全局线性收敛。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes global linear convergence of entropy-regularized softmax policy gradient beyond tabular MDPs with continuous state-action spaces and linear function approximation, by proving non-uniform PL inequalities whose constants remain uniformly bounded below along the gradient flow.
